title: The Practical tool for the trade
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：practical　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 practical 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the fisherman wrote of ① a practical tool for the trade in the logbook, and everybody in the harbour said at once that it was ② so practical that nobody in the harbour would go near it. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the fisherman, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the practical ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the practical tool for the trade that anybody there had ever seen, or so the logbook for July 1959 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too practical to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the boatman who had come to help; the practical ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a practical mind of the engineer, and said that no boatman in his right mind would call it ⑥ as practical as the mind of the engineer they had once had in the old harbour. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was practical or not, and he said so.

By 1972 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the logbook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something practical, and nothing besides. The boatman from the next harbour called the whole plan ⑧ quite practical; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the logbook kept the names of the practical ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1975, in silence, she wrote of another practical tool for the trade in the same logbook, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ no less practical than anybody had expected. ⑩ The practical mind of the engineer that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1977, was the one she could never quite name; the practical ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 实用（前置定语 a practical tool for the trade：1965 年渔人在航海日志里记下的那件实用的工具）
B. adj. 实用／务实（两处加强说法：so practical that … 与 no less practical than …）
C. adj. 实用／务实（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 实用（表语 too practical to do：母亲觉得它太实用，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 务实（前置定语 a practical mind of the engineer：叔叔把整件事称作一桩务实的头脑）
F. adj. 务实（同级比较 as practical as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩工程师务实的头脑相比）
G. adj. 务实（后置定语 something practical：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 务实（受程度副词修饰 quite practical：那位船工的评价）

items.q: a practical tool for the trade
the practical tool for the trade that
a practical mind of the engineer
The practical mind of the engineer that

answers.why: practical 意为“实用”，1965 年渔人在航海日志里记下的是“一件实用的工具”，此处作前置定语 a practical tool for the trade。
practical 意为“实用”，此处用 so practical that 结构，说它实用到渔港里没人敢靠近。
practical 意为“实用”，航海日志上 七月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的实用这一行的实用工具，等于最高级的说法。
practical 意为“实用”，母亲认为这件东西“太实用了，谁也用不上”，too practical to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
practical 意为“务实”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩务实的头脑”，此处作前置定语 a practical mind of the engineer。
practical 意为“务实”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩工程师务实的头脑一样务实”，同级比较用 as practical as。
practical 意为“务实”，航海日志上那半行字要的是“务实的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something practical。
practical 意为“务实”，邻渔港来的那位船工认为这套计划“相当务实”，quite 修饰原级 practical。
practical 意为“务实”，no less practical than 表示“其务实不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之务实不亚于任何人的预料。
practical 意为“务实”，母亲 1977 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的务实头脑”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年，渔人在航海日志里记下了一件实用的工具。（a practical tool for the trade）
它实用到渔港里没有一个人敢靠近。（so practical that …）
母亲觉得它太实用，谁也用不上。（too practical to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩务实的头脑。（a practical mind of the engineer）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩工程师务实的头脑一样务实。（as practical as …）
到了 1972 年，航海日志上只剩半行字：要的是一件务实的东西。（something practical）
answers: In 1965 the fisherman wrote of a practical tool for the trade in the logbook.
It was so practical that nobody in the harbour would go near it.
My mother thought it too practical to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a practical mind of the engineer.
He said nobody would call it as practical as the mind of the engineer they had once had.
By 1972 the logbook asked for nothing but something practical.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 practical 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the fisherman wrote of a practical tool for the trade in the logbook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the practical tool for the trade that anybody there had ever seen, or so the logbook says.
My mother thought it too practical to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a practical mind of the engineer, and nobody argued with him.
The boatman from the next harbour called the plan quite practical, and everybody laughed.
The practical ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
